security.csp: default-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Read and search your agent CLI sessions
bundle.longDescription: Mochi collects the sessions Codex CLI, Claude Code and OpenCode leave on your machine, groups them by repository, and makes them readable and searchable. It works entirely offline and never modifies the original session files.
